reviews.text: Based on my experience, our visit lacked attention to detail, starting with the wait time to schedule a medical appointment. I don't know why they wouldn't let us into the lobby, and we had to wait outside the building. The doctor was impersonal and tactless. The purpose of our visit was a serious health issue, and they took the sample incorrectly. When they gave us the results, they suggested we repeat the test. They were slow to send us the results (and only when we asked for them), even though they had assured us they would be sent within 4-5 days. Unfortunately, we had to discontinue our treatment there. There are many things that need improvement.
Excellent service, thank you very much.

The first time we went, we liked how they groomed my Shih Tzu. I don't remember the groomer's name, but the second time, other people were there—another girl covering for someone on vacation. Everything was fine until we realized they had cut hair we hadn't asked for, and they even said they weren't doing haircuts that day.
It's terrible that they employ unqualified people. Did she want to practice on my Shih Tzu or what? Because she cut the hair above his nose and left a bald patch on one side. In the end, she even told us he didn't have a single knot. ???
We liked the place, but it's mistakes like these that are causing them to lose reputation and customers.

My Shih Tzu is brushed daily, which is why we let his hair grow long. Now we have to wait a long time for it to grow back properly where they cut it. 😡
Excellent place, friends, I highly recommend it. It's managed by a friend who's excellent at what he does. Go, you won't regret it.

Excellent place. Definitely a safe space where my pets return happy. The vet's care is excellent; she's a true professional and very empathetic to our worries when our dogs get sick. Not to mention that when they come for grooming, they leave smelling wonderful, relaxed, and never hurt. 5 stars in every way.
Terrible customer service.

Terrible service, they only shaved half my dog's body. The excuse? "The dog bites." No way, swear to it. If I brought an alligator, I'd understand, but seriously, did they say that about a cocker spaniel? She's just nervous, it's not like she was going to kill it, ridiculous. They don't know how to do their job. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THEM AT ALL. Oh, and they charged me the same as if they had done their job properly, even though one of her paws was red.

I am absolutely delighted with the service my dog ​​received at this grooming salon. My Shih Tzu had the VIP treatment, and the result was very satisfying.
